hypothesis: Narrow intrabasin grabens missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue preserve paired opposite-facing scarps and crest->base dipoles in 100 m LiDAR scarp aggregates; two-sided pairing operators min(upface(x),downface(x+o*d)) and min(lapneg(x),lappos(x+o*d)) detect them where pointwise scarp channels cannot.
mechanism: Paired conjugate normal faults bound a subsided graben floor; each side keeps a low-relief scarp facing the other even under thin alluvium, while catalogue mapping is biased to single range-front scarps.
